title: Implement DPMI INT 31h AX=0101 free DOS memory blocks
description: Complete the DOS-memory allocation lifecycle created by W2-041. Implement AX=0101 with DX selector validation, reclaim the associated DOS paragraphs and MCB, coalesce adjacent free blocks without corrupting the chain, release the protected selector, and test invalid/repeated frees and allocate-free-reallocate behavior. Keep the service bounded to allocations owned by this DosHost and rerun runtime regressions.
acceptance: AX=0101 frees only a currently allocated DOS block selector
Unknown/repeated selector returns DPMI invalid-selector error and CF=1
MCB chain coalesces contiguous free paragraphs and preserves PSP ownership
Reallocation can reuse freed memory without overlapping live allocations
Unit and Unicorn runtime regressions pass
